Interpretation: Human revealed-preference agreement; not pick correctness or causal outcome benefit.
LeakagePolicy: Scoring accepts PickTimeState only; selected pick and DraftOutcome are joined after scoring. Lifetime skill buckets are strata only.
Limitations: Mature aggregates may include future outcomes relative to draft time; this is not a chronological backtest.
Historical pick 15 cannot enter frozen Domain. Other coordinates retain frozen 42/14 stage assumptions.
No Arena slot order, pair stats or trophy corpus; source-column tie order and missing-input fallback are explicit.
Observed maindeck rates do not identify individual copies or a final 23; game builds are not final deck choices.
Common commitment strata use unchanged Phase9A profile, not candidate-dependent/model-dependent predictions.

Phase B actual contextual replay uses 8 whole drafts/dataset chosen by preregistered outcome-independent SHA256, rather than every qualified decision. Older game sources are 20k-row prefixes; modern game sources use 8k hash-selected drafts.
